title: WPMS/808/2004 of CHETAN OM SHARMA Vs JUDGES SMALL CAUSES COURT and ANR

paras.text:
HIGH COURT OF UTTARANCHAL AT NAINITAL
WRIT PETITION NO. 808 (M/S) OF 2004
Shri Chetan Om Sharma.......... .....Petitioner
Vs.
Judge Small Causes Court/
Civil Judge (S.D.) Dehradun and another ........ Respondents
Hon. Rajesh Randon, J.
Heard Sri Kanwaljit Singh/N.S. Pundir counsel for the petitioner. The
suit was filed as back as 2001.
By the present writ petition the petitioner has prayed for a writ of
mandamus directing the respondent no.1 to expedite the hearing of the suit
being SCC no. 14/2001 Chetan Om Sharma Vs. Smt. Ragini Dabral.
Since the suit is an old one and it being a suit of small cause nature, it
requires expeditious hearing. The order sheet shows that unnecessary
adjournments have been granted from time to time.
Parties have already exchanged their pleadings. In the interest of
justice the suit is directed to be heard within period of 6 months from the
filing of the certified copy of the order.
Subject to the aforesaid observations, the writ petition is disposed of.
(Rajesh Tandon J.)
Dated: 28.08.2004
 P.B.
